escapeHatchWithoutReason.text: {{spelling}} tells the compiler to trust this code instead of checking it. Say why that is safe in [[where]], so the next reader can check the reasoning the compiler no longer does.

where.Swift: a comment directly above the declaration
where.Go: a `// Unsafe: <reason>` comment directly above it

unsafeMarkerWithoutReason.text: {{spelling}} is marked `Unsafe:` and gives no reason. Say why it is safe after the colon, such as what keeps the memory alive or what the linked symbol promises, because a marker with nothing after it tells the next reader nothing and excuses nothing.
